text:
The watcher is running. It re-invokes me when the eval run finishes, and I'll commit and push then.

- **WIP:** 131 files are modified or untracked, with no files over 1 MB.
  - The 29 modified files are mostly chat modules and e2e tests, with updates to the eval harness and the vendored khora.
  - The untracked files include `experiments/specimen-assembly/` (36 files), `eval/snips/`, `eval/deid/` and `eval/swarm/`. They also include the new `fold-chat-{flow,gary,monitor,pager,pathos,tipview}` modules with tests and `vendor/khora/native/*`.
- **Secrets:** the scan found only test fixtures and placeholders, such as `sk-ant-api03-FAKEFAKE…` and the `sk-ant-…` input placeholder. Nothing real.
- **Ignored output:** the eval's `.app-cur2/` and `raw-cur2/` folders are already in `.gitignore`, so they won't be committed.
- **The timer:** I read "when it completes" as the `eval/run.mjs --label cur2` run (pid 54886, 18 minutes in, 12 cases). The `*-verify.mjs` jobs in `/private/tmp/.../competence` aren't from this repo, so I'm not waiting on them.
- **Push:** `main` is already one commit ahead of `origin/main`, so pushing sends that commit too.

If you meant a different job, tell me and I'll change what the watcher waits on.

I sent the message to the 7 busy sessions, and all 7 sends were queued:

- The Fold MVP review
- Fold browser e2e testing
- Khora language support gaps
- Heimdall two-node relay architecture
- Heimdall free AI benchmark
- Heimdall dysfunction in scores.patch.points
- Google VM cost for Deepseek GPU

The message tells each session to learn the WIP with `git status --short` and `git diff --stat` in the-fold. The commit and push to `origin/main` happens once the `cur2` eval finishes, and until then they shouldn't stash, reset, checkout, clean, commit or push in that tree. Their saved edits will be in the commit. If a session is mid-change on a file it doesn't want committed half-done, it can reply with the path.

I skipped the 8 idle desktop sessions, the cloud sessions and the offline Remote Control sessions, because messaging an idle session wakes it up to do work. If a session holds the message for its user's approval, a delivery notice will show up here. Silence from a session doesn't mean it agreed.

The eval watcher is still running. Tell me if you want the idle sessions messaged too.

The two unpushed commits are rebuilt without the generated files. The files are untracked, not deleted, so they're all still on disk. Nothing is pushed.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| WIP roundup (`5f01a2c`) | 119 files, 46.8k lines | 110 files, 9.8k lines |
| Pager/tip/contact commit (`721f7b1`) | 13 files, 907 lines | unchanged |

The roundup commit now includes the new `.gitignore`, which I took from the working tree. Untracking `eval/snips/judged.json` and the nine other generated files removed about 37k lines. The rebuild used plumbing, so it didn't touch the working tree or pick up other sessions' newer edits.

Besides `judged.json`, `eval/snips/gold-verify.json` and `asks.json`, the dropped files are:
- `eval/results-cur.json`
- `experiments/specimen-assembly/out/*`
- `experiments/specimen-assembly/vendor/*`

Nothing under `vendor/khora` was dropped, and no previously tracked file became ignored.

- **Backup:** the old commits are saved as branch `backup/pre-trim-wip`. Delete it once you're happy with the result.
- **License file:** the `experiments/specimen-assembly/vendor/` ignore also untracks the `ACORN-LICENSE` file that sits beside `acorn.mjs`. Nothing is shipping that copy, so it's probably fine. You may want to ignore only `acorn.mjs` so the license and `PROVENANCE.json` stay tracked.
- **Push:** I'll hold it until you've seen this result, as the other session asked. It would also still hit the 403 from `clovenbradshaw-ctrl`. Tell me once you've looked, and whether to switch to the `scores-patch-points` account.
- **New edits:** many more files are modified in the tree now, including several `fold-chat-*.js` modules and `eval/snips/*`. These are other sessions' newer work, and I haven't committed any of it.
